series.title: Peerless Divine Emperor
series.synopsis: After being betrayed and ambushed, Jing Yunxiao, the most supreme Emperor of Reincarnation on the Dragon Realm Continent, used the Five-Turn Reincarnation Art to be reborn as a young man from the Jing family in Hongye Town. Using his memories from his previous life, Jing Yunxiao helped his family overcome the threat of the Black Dragon Fortress, but his grandfather, Jing Yufeng, was gravely injured. With no other choice, Jing Yunxiao took on the responsibility of saving his family and went to Huangshi City alone to find medicine.
